issues.concern: The tag 'time-general' is too broad for a specific time unit. 'time-day-of-week' is also not appropriate. This word refers to a specific day of the month or a duration of days.
issues.suggestion: time-general should be replaced with 'time-period' or 'time-day-of-month' if that were an option. Since it is not, 'time-general' is the closest fit among the valid tags, but it is still not ideal. However, given the constraints, I will not flag it as an error.
